claims.text: Nova Quill holds four 2026 Proof Music Awards nominations, including Video of the Year.
Audience discussion going into the 2026 ceremony treats Nova Quill as the night's presumed front-runner.
Cass Tremble holds three 2026 Proof Music Awards nominations, including Song of the Year.
Audience discussion frames Cass Tremble as the veteran overdue for a first top-category win.
Halcyon Drift holds three 2026 Proof Music Awards nominations across video and production categories.
Audience discussion of Halcyon Drift concentrates on the staging of the nominated videos rather than the songs.
Mirrorbird holds two 2026 Proof Music Awards nominations, both in performance categories.
Audience discussion treats Mirrorbird as the most likely upset winner of the night.
Lu Vanta holds two 2026 Proof Music Awards nominations, including Best New Artist.
Audience discussion of Lu Vanta is dominated by a first-ceremony arrival rather than by the nominated work.
Saint Omen holds three 2026 Proof Music Awards nominations, including Best Collaboration.
Audience discussion expects Saint Omen to convert a long run of nominations into a first win.
The 2026 Proof Music Awards is scheduled as a three-hour live broadcast carrying eleven on-air awards.
Five 2026 Proof Music Awards categories are decided off air and published in one official results post on the night.
The 2026 broadcast opens with a thirty-minute arrivals pre-show carried on the same feed.
The 2025 telecast opened with a full performance before the first award was announced.
Play-off music interrupted three acceptance speeches during the 2025 telecast.
The 2025 host named several nominees during the opening monologue before the first envelope was opened.
The 2025 telecast cut to seated nominees before every envelope was opened.
A career tribute segment in the 2025 telecast ended in a standing ovation.
A microphone fault interrupted one 2025 acceptance speech for several seconds.
The 2025 telecast closed with a duet between two nominated artists.
One 2025 winner dropped a trophy on stage while leaving the podium.
Every 2025 acceptance speech thanked at least one family member.
Presenter pairs read most of the 2025 envelopes together on stage.
Two 2025 winners read their acceptance speeches from a phone screen.
An unannounced guest joined a scheduled performance during the 2025 telecast.
Winning collaborators shared the podium in two 2025 categories.
Two 2025 performers changed outfits between the arrivals feed and their performance.
One 2025 winner accepted a trophy without speaking.
A 2025 presenter misread a nominee's name and corrected it on air.
No Proof Music Awards category has ever been declared a tie across the ceremony's recorded history.
The 2025 telecast ran eleven minutes past its scheduled end.
A first-time nominee won a top category at the 2025 ceremony.
No artist won more than three categories at any of the last three Proof Music Awards ceremonies.
One 2025 nominee was shown on camera losing two categories during the same broadcast.
Audience sentiment before the 2026 ceremony expects at least one of the leading nominees to take multiple categories.
Audience chatter during recent ceremonies concentrates on arrivals outfits more than on the awards themselves.
Audience sentiment before the 2026 ceremony favors an upset in the newcomer category.
Viewers of recent ceremonies routinely complain that play-off music cuts speeches short.
The house style guide asks the record-keeping voice to state each result plainly and to claim nothing the record has not given it.
The house style guide allows exactly one openly partisan voice who never pretends to be neutral.
The house style guide keeps a long-memory critic who measures every night against the ceremonies that came before it.
The house style guide keeps one voice assigned to arrivals, outfits and crowd reactions rather than to results.

predictions.title: Video of the Year
predictions.condition: The Proof Music Awards names this artist the official winner of Video of the Year, on air or in the official results post published the same night.
exclusions: A nomination, a performance slot, or a presenter appearance does not count as a win.
An artist credited only as a featured guest on another nominee's entry does not count as that entry's winner.

title_review.note: The title names the ceremony's marquee category and the condition requires that exact official result, nothing broader.

predictions.title: Song of the Year
predictions.condition: The Proof Music Awards names this artist the official winner of Song of the Year, on air or in the official results post published the same night.
exclusions: A nomination, a performance slot, or a presenter appearance does not count as a win.
An artist credited only as a featured guest on another nominee's entry does not count as that entry's winner.

title_review.note: The title names one official category and the condition resolves on that category's announced winner alone.

predictions.title: Best New Artist
predictions.condition: The Proof Music Awards names this artist the official winner of Best New Artist, on air or in the official results post published the same night.
exclusions: A nomination, a performance slot, or a presenter appearance does not count as a win.
An artist credited only as a featured guest on another nominee's entry does not count as that entry's winner.

title_review.note: The title promises the newcomer category and the condition requires that category's announced winner.

predictions.title: Best Choreography
predictions.condition: The Proof Music Awards names this artist the official winner of Best Choreography, on air or in the official results post published the same night.
exclusions: A nomination, a performance slot, or a presenter appearance does not count as a win.
An artist credited only as a featured guest on another nominee's entry does not count as that entry's winner.

title_review.note: The title names a craft category awarded to the credited artist, which is exactly what the condition resolves.

predictions.title: Best Collaboration
predictions.condition: The Proof Music Awards names this artist as a credited winner of Best Collaboration, on air or in the official results post published the same night.
exclusions: A nomination, a performance slot, or a presenter appearance does not count as a win.
An artist credited only as a featured guest on another nominee's entry does not count as that entry's winner.

title_review.note: The title promises a shared award and the condition credits every artist the official result names.

signature_beats.title: Nova Quill Wins Two Or More
signature_beats.condition: The official 2026 results credit Nova Quill as a winner in two or more categories, counting the on-air awards and the official off-air results post together.
exclusions: Nominations, presenter slots and performance slots do not count toward the category total.
An unofficial tally, a leak, or a prediction published before the results post does not count.

title_review.note: The title states the exact category count the condition requires and names every artist it depends on.

signature_beats.pitch: The front-runner is priced as a coin flip, so the safe-looking pick is not free.

signature_beats.title: Cass Tremble Wins Two Or More
signature_beats.condition: The official 2026 results credit Cass Tremble as a winner in two or more categories, counting the on-air awards and the official off-air results post together.
exclusions: Nominations, presenter slots and performance slots do not count toward the category total.
An unofficial tally, a leak, or a prediction published before the results post does not count.

title_review.note: The title states the exact category count the condition requires and names every artist it depends on.

signature_beats.pitch: Three nominations is exactly enough to make two wins plausible and never comfortable.

signature_beats.title: Halcyon Drift Wins Two Or More
signature_beats.condition: The official 2026 results credit Halcyon Drift as a winner in two or more categories, counting the on-air awards and the official off-air results post together.
exclusions: Nominations, presenter slots and performance slots do not count toward the category total.
An unofficial tally, a leak, or a prediction published before the results post does not count.

title_review.note: The title states the exact category count the condition requires and names every artist it depends on.

signature_beats.pitch: A craft-heavy slate can quietly stack two trophies while the room watches the marquee categories.

signature_beats.title: Mirrorbird Wins Two Or More
signature_beats.condition: The official 2026 results credit Mirrorbird as a winner in two or more categories, counting the on-air awards and the official off-air results post together.
exclusions: Nominations, presenter slots and performance slots do not count toward the category total.
An unofficial tally, a leak, or a prediction published before the results post does not count.

title_review.note: The title states the exact category count the condition requires and names every artist it depends on.

signature_beats.pitch: Two nominations means this only pays if both of them land.

signature_beats.title: Lu Vanta Wins Two Or More
signature_beats.condition: The official 2026 results credit Lu Vanta as a winner in two or more categories, counting the on-air awards and the official off-air results post together.
exclusions: Nominations, presenter slots and performance slots do not count toward the category total.
An unofficial tally, a leak, or a prediction published before the results post does not count.

title_review.note: The title states the exact category count the condition requires and names every artist it depends on.

signature_beats.pitch: A newcomer sweeping both nominations is the cheapest way to own the story of the night.

signature_beats.title: Saint Omen And Mirrorbird Both Win
signature_beats.condition: The official 2026 results credit Saint Omen with at least one category and Mirrorbird with at least one category, counting the on-air awards and the official off-air results post together.
exclusions: Nominations, presenter slots and performance slots do not count toward the category total.
An unofficial tally, a leak, or a prediction published before the results post does not count.

title_review.note: The title states the exact category count the condition requires and names every artist it depends on.

signature_beats.pitch: One pick, two artists, and it only pays if the night spreads its trophies around.

bingo_squares.title: Play-Off Music Cuts A Speech
bingo_squares.condition: Play-off music starts under an acceptance speech while the winner is still talking during the live broadcast.
exclusions: Music under a presenter, a transition, or a performance does not count.
A speech that ends before the music starts does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: Everyone recognizes the exact moment the room stops belonging to the winner.

bingo_squares.title: Host Names A Nominee
bingo_squares.condition: The host names at least one nominated artist out loud during the opening monologue.
exclusions: Naming a presenter, a performer, or a past winner who is not nominated this year does not count.
A name that appears only on a graphic does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: It is the first moment the room learns which way the night intends to lean.

bingo_squares.title: Crowd Cutaway Before An Envelope
bingo_squares.condition: The broadcast cuts to a seated nominee's face after the category is read and before the envelope is opened.
exclusions: A cutaway after the winner is announced does not count.
A wide audience shot with no identifiable nominee does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The camera tells you who the producers think is about to lose.

bingo_squares.title: Winner Thanks Family
bingo_squares.condition: A winner thanks a named family member out loud during an on-air acceptance speech.
exclusions: Thanking a label, a manager, a band, or fans does not count.
A thank-you shown only in on-screen text does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The most predictable line in awards television is still the one that lands.

bingo_squares.title: Performance Opens The Show
bingo_squares.condition: A full musical performance airs before the first award of the night is announced.
exclusions: The arrivals pre-show and its interviews do not count.
Walk-on music under the host's entrance does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The show tells you what it is before it tells you who won anything.

bingo_squares.title: Full-Screen Outfit Shot
bingo_squares.condition: The arrivals pre-show holds a full-screen head-to-toe shot of one artist's outfit.
exclusions: A group shot on the step-and-repeat does not count.
A waist-up interview framing does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: One voice in this room has been waiting all night for exactly this frame.

bingo_squares.title: Host Reads An Off-Air Result
bingo_squares.condition: The host or a presenter reads out a category decided off air during the live broadcast.
exclusions: A graphic listing off-air winners with no one reading it does not count.
The official post-ceremony results post does not count for this square.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The off-air categories are where a quiet draft pick turns into points.

bingo_squares.title: Standing Ovation
bingo_squares.condition: The room stands and applauds during or immediately after a tribute or honorary segment.
exclusions: Applause from seated attendees does not count.
A standing ovation after an ordinary acceptance speech does not count for this square.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: It is the one minute of the night nobody in the room is competing for.

bingo_squares.title: Two Presenters, One Envelope
bingo_squares.condition: Two presenters read the same category together on stage, passing or sharing the envelope.
exclusions: A single presenter with a silent escort does not count.
Two presenters reading two different categories does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The bit either works immediately or dies in front of everyone.

bingo_squares.title: Speech Read From A Phone
bingo_squares.condition: A winner visibly reads an acceptance speech from a phone screen on stage.
exclusions: Reading from paper or a card does not count.
Holding a phone without reading from it does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The note was written in the car and everyone can tell.

bingo_squares.title: Losing Face On Camera
bingo_squares.condition: The broadcast holds on a losing nominee's reaction in the seconds after a winner is announced.
exclusions: A cutaway before the envelope is opened does not count.
A shot of the winner's table does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: This is the shot the room will argue about for the rest of the night.

bingo_squares.title: Duet Closes The Show
bingo_squares.condition: Two or more credited artists perform together in the broadcast's final performance slot.
exclusions: A solo closing performance with backing vocalists does not count.
A group medley that is not the final performance does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The finale is the producers' last chance to make the night mean something.

bingo_squares.title: Speech Past Ninety Seconds
bingo_squares.condition: One on-air acceptance speech runs longer than ninety seconds from the first word to the last.
exclusions: Time spent walking to the podium does not count.
Two winners splitting one speech slot are timed as one speech.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: Somebody always decides the clock does not apply to them.

bingo_squares.title: Host Jokes About The Clock
bingo_squares.condition: The host makes an explicit joke about how long the broadcast is running.
exclusions: A generic joke about the schedule of the week does not count.
A producer or presenter making the joke does not count for this square.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The show admitting it is long is the show admitting it is losing.

bingo_squares.title: First-Time Nominee Wins
bingo_squares.condition: An artist receiving their first Proof Music Awards nomination this year wins a category during the broadcast.
exclusions: A first win by a previously nominated artist does not count.
An off-air result published after the broadcast does not count for this square.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The upset everyone says they want is only fun if somebody bet on it.

bingo_squares.title: Outfit Change Mid-Show
bingo_squares.condition: One artist appears in visibly different outfits at two separate points of the live broadcast.
exclusions: A change between the arrivals pre-show and the broadcast does not count.
Removing or adding a jacket does not count as a change.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: Tracking this properly requires actually watching the crowd shots.

bingo_squares.title: Collaborator Joins The Podium
bingo_squares.condition: A winner brings a credited collaborator up to the podium and that collaborator speaks.
exclusions: A collaborator who stands silently does not count.
A category whose winners were all announced together does not count for this square.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The shared award is where the night's alliances become visible.

bingo_squares.title: Technical Fault On Air
bingo_squares.condition: A visible or audible technical fault interrupts the live broadcast for at least several seconds.
exclusions: A brief audio bleep for censorship does not count.
A viewer's own streaming buffer does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: Live television failing in public is the last unscripted thing left.

bingo_squares.title: Trophy Hits The Floor
bingo_squares.condition: A trophy is dropped and hits the stage or floor on camera.
exclusions: A trophy fumbled but caught does not count.
A trophy set down deliberately does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: It is nobody's fault and everybody's favorite moment.

bingo_squares.title: Winner Says Nothing
bingo_squares.condition: A winner accepts a trophy on stage and leaves without giving a speech.
exclusions: A speech cut short by play-off music does not count.
An absent winner whose award is accepted by someone else does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: Silence on that stage is louder than anything anyone prepared.

bingo_squares.title: Presenter Misreads A Name
bingo_squares.condition: A presenter says a nominee's or winner's name incorrectly on air.
exclusions: A deliberate joke mispronunciation does not count.
A stumble that is corrected inside the same word does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: Everyone hears it, and then everyone pretends they did not.

bingo_squares.title: Surprise Guest Performer
bingo_squares.condition: An artist not listed for that performance slot joins it on stage during the broadcast.
exclusions: A scheduled featured artist named in the broadcast listing does not count.
A backing band or dance ensemble does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The one thing the run-of-show is not allowed to tell you in advance.

bingo_squares.title: Three-Category Night
bingo_squares.condition: One artist is credited as a winner in three or more categories across the broadcast and the official results post.
exclusions: Nominations do not count toward the total.
Shared collaboration credits count once per category, not once per artist.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: This is the night that reshapes the leaderboard in one line.

bingo_squares.title: Two Losses, One Camera
bingo_squares.condition: The broadcast shows the same nominee reacting to losing two separate categories.
exclusions: Two cutaways to the same nominee for one category do not count.
A nominee shown reacting to someone else's category does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: The second cutaway is where sympathy turns into comedy.

bingo_squares.title: A Declared Tie
bingo_squares.condition: The ceremony declares two artists joint winners of the same category.
exclusions: A shared collaboration award credited to multiple artists for one entry does not count.
An announced error later corrected to a single winner does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: It has never happened, which is exactly why somebody will take it.

bingo_squares.title: Show Ends Early
bingo_squares.condition: The live broadcast signs off before its scheduled end time.
exclusions: Ending on time to the minute does not count.
A regional feed cutting away early does not count.

title_review.note: The title names exactly the moment the condition requires and promises nothing wider.

bingo_squares.why_it_is_fun: Three hours of television finishing early would be the real upset.

commentary_voices.name: Tally
commentary_voices.instruction: State what the record shows in short, plain sentences and never claim a result the record has not given you.

farewell.instruction: Close the room by reading the final standings plainly, with no verdict of your own.

keepsake.instruction: Summarize one player's night from the recorded picks and results, without ranking their taste.

commentary_voices.name: Flare
commentary_voices.instruction: Speak as an openly partisan fan of whoever the room has just seen win, and never pretend to be neutral.

farewell.instruction: Close the room by defending your favorite of the night one last time.

keepsake.instruction: Tell one player which of their commitments you would have made yourself.

commentary_voices.name: Archivum
commentary_voices.instruction: Measure tonight against the ceremonies that came before it, citing only what you have been given.

farewell.instruction: Close the room by placing tonight in the ceremony's longer record.

keepsake.instruction: Judge one player's night against the recorded pattern of the evening.

commentary_voices.name: Glimmer
commentary_voices.instruction: Care about arrivals, outfits and crowd reactions, and treat the awards themselves as background.

farewell.instruction: Close the room with a last word on how the night looked rather than how it scored.

keepsake.instruction: Describe one player's night as if it were an outfit you are reviewing.

voices.instruction: Name the checkpoint and read only the recorded standings.
React to the first three results as the partisan you are.
Compare the first three results to the pattern of earlier ceremonies.
Report what the room and the arrivals looked like across the first three results.
